thread:
jia: Quick update — GALILEO-1 weights are uploaded to s3://redwood-models/galileo-1/v1/ (sha256: 3f8a2...). Putting this here so infra + docs can pick it up.

matt: got it. do we have the tokenizer files next to weights? last time tokens split caused partial utf-8 boundaries.

sara: yes, tokenizer files are at s3://redwood-models/galileo-1/v1/tokenizer/ — vocab.json, merges.txt, and tokenizer_config.json

jia: note: the tokenizer uses a legacy byte-level BPE with an extra <sentinel> token (id 50265). It's not in our standard HF mapping; please map in serving config or regen tokenizers.

eva: @jia can you paste the minimal serving config snippet? saves me a round-trip.

jia: sure — minimal snippet:
```
model_name: galileo-1
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/galileo-1/v1/weights.bin
tokenizer:
  type: bytelevel-bpe
  vocab_path: s3://redwood-models/galileo-1/v1/tokenizer/vocab.json
  merges_path: s3://redwood-models/galileo-1/v1/tokenizer/merges.txt
  special_tokens:
    - id: 50265
      token: <sentinel>
```

matt: will add validation for special token IDs in the config validator (PR incoming).

laura: heads-up for docs: model name for customers should be "galileo-1" (lowercase). product asked for a capability blurb — any rough notes?

jia: draft capability notes: good multi-turn reasoning, strong code completion for Python/SQL, known quirks: sometimes repeats long tails with temperature <0.2, tokenizer can split long unicode emoji sequences into many tokens. Also best used with max_new_tokens<=512 for latency.

product-sam: thanks — can you add a short "what to expect" for enterprise (private) deployments? we need to call out tokenizer mapping and that quantized variants are experimental.

sara: quick infra note: dedicated images built; deploy-bot reports: 

deploy-bot: [build] galileo-1: image redwood/galileo-1:v1 built (sha: c7a9).
deploy-bot: [smoke] inference smoke tests passed on g4dn.xlarge (latency median ~47ms for 128 tokens).

matt: smoke tests uncovered a corner — KV-cache size config defaulted to 0 in some envs, which causes repeated context re-encode. PR #412 will set default to 1024*32 and add a fail-open warning.

eva: pinging @laura — can you shepherd the customer-facing announcement? draft copied below, please shorten to ~3 bullets: 
- Name: galileo-1 (v1) — modern open LLM for multi-turn product assistants.
- Highlights: strong code + reasoning; low-moderate latency (hosted med tier).
- Notes: legacy byte-level BPE (special token <sentinel>), emoji splitting, quantized builds experimental.

laura: will trim and send to comms. can we add a short example prompt + expected output size? helps support.

jia: example prompt: "Write a unit test for function that reverses unicode strings" — expected ~120 tokens.

product-sam: also add guidance for model selection: recommend galileo-1 for code + multi-turn, or galileo-lite for cheap embeddings-only workloads (separate announcement).

sara: checklist for launch (quick):
- [x] weights uploaded
- [x] tokenizer files uploaded
- [x] image built + smoke tests
- [ ] PR for config validator merged (matt)
- [ ] docs page + announcement draft (laura)
- [ ] canary rollout (eng-runtime)

matt: targeting PR merge today, canary tomorrow if no regressions.

eva: I'll schedule a brief canary monitor alert rule for token growth/regression.

laura: draft announcement posted to #announcements tomorrow 10:00 PT unless objections.

jia: no objections from me. thanks team — I'll file a small follow-up with the tokenizer normalization script and example mapping for HF clients.

product-sam: perfect. if support gets any tokenizer mismatch tickets, tag @jia and @sara. :thumbsup:
